content_fields.title: Verify that containers are not run as root (Docker)
content_fields.description: Drop root before the application runs and remove the passwordless sudo grant that lets the runtime user regain it.
content_fields.finding: A non-root user is created only after a sudoers rule granting passwordless sudo is installed, so the container user can regain root.
content_fields.current_code:
RUN echo 'ALL ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/find' | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.d/find_nopasswd > /dev/null

RUN useradd -m app
RUN chown app .
USER app
content_fields.required_fix:
# Dockerfile
FROM python:3.10-slim-bookworm AS runtime

RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libpq5 \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN useradd --create-home --uid 10001 app
COPY --from=builder --chown=app:app /app/requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY --chown=app:app app ./app
WORKDIR /app
USER 10001
criteria: The sudoers rule and the sudo package are gone from the image.
`docker run --rm <image> id -u` prints a non-zero uid.
The compose service sets `user: "10001:10001"` as well.
